text: {Name}, a shepherd from {Place}, guided displaced neighbours along familiar grazing paths. A cousin stayed behind to tend the flock; the shepherd lost contact with that cousin during the journey.
self_review: The shepherd guided displaced neighbours away while a cousin tended the flock, then lost contact with the cousin.
source_pattern: The supplied forest-fighter interview describes reliance on village support and the hardship when that support was cut off.
fictional_changes: The shepherd, guidance along grazing routes, and missing flock keeper are fictional extrapolations; these actions are not in the interview.
